name: Bendinsight
description: Feel two currents of qi in the arms, one for each hand, and learn to let them run apart.

name: Longedge Wrath
description: Draw the blade across from the left bank of the body so the first stream leads the cut.

name: Gustbend
description: Return across the same line from the right with the second stream driving the edge.

name: Granite Bladespine
description: Wheel the blade with the two streams of qi running in opposite directions so the edge bites doubly.

name: Charter Tangheel
description: Hold the shaft with both streams running along it so a blow meets two layers of qi at once.

name: Chime Slicefall
description: Split a stream of qi in the blade at the point of contact to jar the foe's grip two ways.

name: Shattering Longcut
description: Cut from two directions in half a breath so the streams meet in the target and burst.

name: Lotreave
description: Part the foe's guard with one stream, step through with the second and cut where it opened.

name: Lacerating Windrake
description: Gather both streams into one crescent of qi and let it fall on the foe like two rivers joined over a cliff.

name: Resurgent Spineedge
description: Draw the blade up in a rising arc and feel the first curve of the moon in the stroke.

name: Glaivewrath
description: Let the blade fall away in a fading arc that ends just past the opponent's body.

name: Guardlug Nerve
description: Parry with a crescent arc and answer at once with a second arc in the other direction.

name: Phantom Edgeswing
description: Glide round the opponent in a half circle with the blade's curve always facing him.

name: Gustreave
description: Meet a rising arc with a falling arc so two crescents close on the target like jaws.

name: Thornbend
description: Spin the blade into a round screen of qi that hides the body from a straight thrust.

name: Chime Glaiveblade
description: Pull the blade back along a long arc with qi so the foe's weapon is drawn after it.

name: Crookhavoc
description: Complete the circle in one turn so both arcs of the blade strike every attacker around the body.

name: Hour Cutbelly
description: Let the blade vanish behind the shoulder, then return from two angles as the foe loses its track.

name: Hellish Ferrulecap
description: Descend with two crescent arcs of qi in succession so the second lands in the wound the first opened.

name: Glaivevigil
description: Stand wide and long with the blade out, feeling the far rim of the reach as the edge of a basin.

name: Elevating Curvetip
description: Stretch a bright film of qi along the curve so it feels a pace longer in the hands.

name: Tempered Glaiveblade
description: Lunge to the limit of the reach and cut with the last finger's width of the edge.

name: Ferrulecap Whirlpool
description: Return from a lunge in a smooth slide that brings the feet back under the body.

name: Unbowed Cutbelly
description: Keep the foe at the far rim by turning aside each probing point with the tip.

name: Grievous Glavesocket
description: Send a second cut of qi out half a pace beyond the first in the same swing.

name: Blaze Tangheel
description: Sweep so the qi on the curve carries the arc a pace beyond the steel.

name: Hoarfrost Curvecut
description: Cast a ring of qi from the blade's curve onto a distant limb and draw it in.

name: Chime Edgeswing
description: Pull the blade back as though the reach were spent, then stab far beyond it with qi.

name: Eviscerating Bladespine
description: Cut a great arc of azure qi that flies from the blade and lands on a foe beyond its reach.

name: Punishing Guardlug
description: Thrust along the whole length of the shaft with qi following so the point pins a foe at the far rim.

name: Pitiless Glavesocket
description: Hold the stance and loose one unbroken cut of qi that crosses the whole basin of the duel and ends at the foe.

name: Longedge Respite
description: Hold the blade high so its shadow falls long over the foe and shows how he shifts.

name: Bendwrath
description: Bring the blade down from above on the line of its own shadow.

name: Silt Longcut
description: Circle the foe at the length of the shaft with the blade held high and steady.

name: Hollowcutter
description: Pluck at a gap in the guard with the tip like a hawk's beak taking a seed from a husk.

name: Facetbend
description: Spread the shaft and blade across the body like a wing to shade it from a blow.

name: Mayhem Reave
description: Send the shadow of the blade ahead of the edge so the foe's guard goes to the wrong place.

name: Eviscerating Curvecut
description: Drag the edge down the target after the dive as a hawk rakes with its talons.

name: Charter Curvetip
description: Fix the tip on one point of the foe's body and let qi press his every move toward it.

name: Confluent Windrake
description: Strike where the first stroke's shadow fell, then where the second's falls, and ground the foe.

name: Iron Slicefall
description: Plunge from above with the whole body behind the edge so the stroke breaks a guard in two.

name: Blistering Reave Scourge
description: Vanish as a shadow, then land the edge from above with qi enough to cut through plate and the bone beneath.

name: Probing Guardlug
description: Read the foe's feet as stones across a ford to find which will bear his weight.

name: Gustglaive
description: Advance by short firm steps, each planted before the next begins.

name: Thornglaive
description: Stand like a post in the stream so the foe's rush must pass on either side.

name: Cutbelly Havoc
description: Cut as the foe steps from one place to the next so his weight cannot recover.

name: Overpowering Bladespine
description: Rap the shaft against a lifted foot so his stride is broken between its two tracks.

name: Siltbend
description: Sweep along both tracks of an opponent's stride at once so neither foot is safe.

name: Murkglaive
description: Turn a blow with a swirl of qi that sends it down the stream and away from the body.

name: Tangheel Valor
description: Pull the shaft under a foe's leading foot with qi to wash his footing from beneath him.

name: Gyvebend
description: Pin a foe's lead foot to the ground with the blade's heel and a short press of qi.

name: Hourcrook
description: Cut, step, cut and step again across the foe's front until he stands on the wrong bank.

name: Sanguine Curvecut
description: Hew along one track of the foe's stance and follow along the other before he can shift.

name: Edgeswing Ruin
description: Surge forward like rising water with the whole edge sweeping the front rank off its feet.

name: Tempered Spineedge
description: Break the crossing in one qi-charged stroke that cuts through the foe's stance and the guard above it.

name: Verity Curvetip
description: Feel the keen silver of the edge and the soft blue of the qi that flows beside it.

name: Spineedge Ruin
description: Draw the edge in a bright silver line across the foe's guard.

name: Chimeglaive
description: Let the qi run blue along the shaft and take a blow as water takes a stone.

name: Ironbend
description: Back the silver cut with a blue surge of qi that follows it through the target.

name: Gyve Ferrulecap
description: Close a blue eddy of qi around the foe's blade and hold it in the turning flow.

name: Bendruin
description: Catch the foe's cut on the silver rim and return it along the same line before he recovers.

name: Hour Glavesocket
description: Move the crescent through the foe's attack as through a current, parrying and cutting in one stroke.

name: Unbudging Tangheel
description: Raise a tide of blue qi in front of the blade that swallows arrows, stones and thrown blades.

name: Hellish Longcut Havoc
description: Loose a silver crescent of qi over a blue wave and let both carry the cut through the guard.

name: Waning Bladespine
description: Stand at the centre of a ring of foes and feel each one's weight pressing outward on the rim.

name: Bendvalor
description: Hold the blade overhead like a crown so cuts from every side meet steel or shaft.

name: Sanguine Windrake
description: Cut at whichever side of the ring presses first and recover to the centre.

name: Torrent Slicefall
description: Step out along a spoke to cut and back to the hub before the ring can close.

name: Silt Guardlug
description: Sweep qi through the ring at waist height so every side is cut at once.

name: Torrent Spineedge
description: Turn the shaft so attackers' own blows pass into one another across the ring.

name: Hourreave
description: Hold the blade out in a slow circle with qi, keeping the whole ring from stepping in.

name: Hour Longedge
description: Cut, guard and sweep in turn around the ring so no side is ever left to recover.

name: Bendscourge
description: Break the ring at its weakest point in a single heavy cleave and walk out through the gap.

name: Corroding Blaze Glaiveblade
description: Raise the blade and let qi fall on every side as a crown of azure edges that cuts all within the basin.

name: Vigilant Ferrulecap
description: Swear the stance aloud, then hold it as steadily as the plateau holds its stone.

name: Punishing Windrake
description: Cut in the arc named in the oath and let no gust of wind bend it.

name: Iron Cutbelly
description: Press the feet into the bare stone so a charge cannot shift the stance.

name: Gust Curvecut
description: Advance to a marked place on the ground and stop there however the foe moves.

name: Crookruin
description: Thrust from the sworn stance straight along the line the oath set for it.

name: Ferocious Longedge
description: Hew with qi sworn to the blow so that it is not spent before it lands.

name: Cutterspine
description: Meet the blow with a rising wind of qi from the shaft and lift it off the line.

name: Slicefall Obduracy
description: Hold the sworn ground and let qi weigh upon the foe until he gives way.

name: Lotbend
description: Chain the cuts in the order sworn and let none be dropped even if the foe changes.

name: Crookscourge
description: Bring the whole blade down with qi so the stroke shakes the stone under both fighters.

name: Daybreak Glaiveblade
description: Reap the open ground with a vast crescent of sworn qi that no foe can outrun on the plateau.

name: Waningcutter
description: Take the bearing of the foe and swear to keep it until the fight is done.

name: Iron Edgeswing
description: Cut along the held bearing so the edge never leaves the line of the oath.

name: Gust Spineedge
description: Parry without losing the bearing by turning only the wrists and never the feet.

name: Gnashing Glavesocket
description: Fix the tip on the bearing and thrust with qi sworn to arrive exactly there.

name: Glaivevalor
description: Walk forward on the held bearing so the foe's steps are pushed back along it.

name: Reavedurance
description: Snap the shaft against his weapon in a sworn parry that rattles his hold.

name: Crookwrath
description: Cut, thrust and parry on one unchanging bearing until the foe is run onto the point.

name: Ruinous Longcut
description: Strike down the exact bearing with the whole weight of the blade and split what lies upon it.

name: Gust Guardlug
description: Deliver the one cut sworn from the first breath, with all the qi the oath was keeping in reserve.

name: Buoying Glaiveblade
description: Listen to the long wind across open land and learn from it where the foe stands.

name: Windrake Wrath
description: Lunge with the wind behind the swing so the reach is a hand longer than usual.

name: Granite Tangheel
description: Step across the wind so that its push covers the lunge to follow.

name: Facet Longedge
description: Turn the body to the lee of the blade so a blow must fight the wind to reach it.

name: Ironglaive
description: Drive the point into a headwind low and tight so the gust cannot swing it.

name: Gust Ferrulecap
description: Gather qi from the long wind into the edge and hew with its steady weight.

name: Silt Curvecut
description: Sweep in a great curtain of qi that falls across the ground like a gale across a field.

name: Mayhem Bladespine
description: Shear the edge across the foe's guard so qi tears it as a gust tears a banner.

name: Fastening Reave
description: Pin the foe's weapon in place with qi held steady as wind held in a still hand.

name: Intentglaive
description: Chain strokes of rising force so each takes up the strength the wind gave the last.

name: Granite Curvetip
description: Split an oncoming gust of qi with the edge and strike on through the foe behind it.

name: Hellish Slicefall
description: Loose the whole wind stored in the blade as one rushing crescent that strikes a line of foes together.

name: Waning Glavesocket
description: Take a bearing along the plateau edge and keep the foe on the landward side of it.

name: Blistering Curvetip
description: Cut at the outer shoulder so the foe's every parry turns him toward the drop.

name: Phantom Cutbelly
description: Tread the rim itself with the blade held level so balance is never lost to the drop.

name: Unrelenting Spineedge
description: Hold the shaft slanted toward the drop so a charge must break against it or fall.

name: Might Longcut
description: Hew with qi sheeting off the edge so the force of the stroke shoves the foe sideways.

name: Harnessing Guardlug
description: Pull the foe's lead leg toward the drop with the blade's heel and a short surge of qi.

name: Torrent Bladespine
description: Retreat along the edge with the foe held on the same bearing so he cannot close.

name: Doctrine Reave
description: Chain cuts as the feet tread the edge so each stroke turns the foe closer to the drop.

name: Sanguine Cutbelly
description: Cleave down the line of the edge so the stroke breaks the stone and the guard above it.

name: Eviscerating Blaze Glavesocket
description: Take the last bearing and strike once along it with qi gathered from every earlier step of the fight.

name: Waningcrook
description: Survey the open land where no hindrance stands and judge the foe's lines of approach.

name: Pitiless Longcut
description: Cut low across open ground with the gale at the back so nothing slows the stroke.

name: Might Glaiveblade
description: Take a wide curving step round the foe so every path to him is clear of cover.

name: Aegis Ferrulecap
description: Keep the guard in open air with the shaft held steady since no cover is there to retreat to.

name: Glint Edgeswing
description: Run three steps and thrust at the end of them so the whole run drives the point.

name: Iron Curvetip
description: Reap with qi trailing the crescent like the long tail of a gale.

name: Slag Slicefall
description: Sweep qi flat and far so the stroke has nothing to catch on and carries on.

name: Torrent Tangheel
description: Turn a blow with a gale of qi and let it bear the foe's own force back at him.

name: Immobilizing Windrake
description: Pin a foe's weapon where he stands with qi alone and no post or cover to help.

name: Doctrine Curvecut
description: Cut, run and cut again over open ground so the foe cannot find an obstacle to turn on.

name: Gust Longedge
description: Bring a crescent of gale qi down on the guard so it opens from rim to centre.

name: Dismantling Edgeswing
description: Break a charging line with a single great sweep that lifts the front rank off its feet.

name: Dismantling Curvecut
description: Let the crescent run free across the open country on a gale of qi that stops only at the foe.

name: Waning Tangheel
description: Count the breath of the wind and begin the reaping stroke on its fall.

name: Glaivescourge
description: Cut low and long in the manner of a reaper laying down a row of grain.

name: Silt Bladespine
description: Advance in short steps along the cut line so each stroke begins where the last ended.

name: Longedge Ruin
description: Reap forward and then bring the edge back through the same row on a returning stroke.

name: Equipoise Cutbelly
description: Part an incoming swath of blows with the blade as a reaper parts the standing grain.

name: Suffocating Spineedge
description: Bind the foe's arms against his body with the shaft as a sheaf is bound by a cord.

name: Multiplying Reave
description: Reap row after row in order so each stroke clears the ground the next must cross.

name: Mayhem Slicefall
description: Cut a wide swath through the foe's line with one great crescent of qi from the blade.

name: Might Ferrulecap
description: Reap the last standing foe with a single stroke carrying all the qi the earlier strokes stored.

name: Glavesocket Vigil
description: Speak the last oath under the breath and feel the blade settle to its work.

name: Rumbleglaive
description: Cut with the weight of the oath behind the swing so the stroke cannot be turned back.

name: Facet Glaiveblade
description: Stand fast with the shaft crossed as an oath to give no ground, taking each blow squarely.

name: Reave Slipstream
description: Step along the bearing straight toward the foe and never turn from it.

name: Tempered Windrake
description: Prod at the heart of the guard to learn whether the foe will keep or break his own.

name: Unsparing Reave
description: Rip the edge through the foe's guard with qi sworn never to slacken until it clears.

name: Ponderous Edgeswing
description: Press forward under the oath so steadily that the foe's resolve begins to bend.

name: Numbing Tangheel
description: Hold the foe's weapon bound under the blade until the oath is done and then release it.

name: Doctrine Longcut
description: Chain the sworn strokes without pause until the oath is kept or the blade falls.

name: Rampaging Curvetip
description: Cleave with the whole oath behind the blade to split a guard that was itself sworn unbreakable.

name: Cutterwrath
description: Spend every last breath of qi in one stroke, the final sworn cut of the long blade.
